question: Why is Hari willing to reveal the teaching to his listener?
premises: Hari promises to tell the requested matter.
Hari states there is no doubt about this.
Hari affirms the listener is his devoted and virtuous follower.
inference: Hari will disclose the teaching because the listener is a worthy devotee.
plain_english: I shall tell you that; there is no doubt. You are my devotee, O virtuous one.
